description: A Southern-style front porch photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, three-quarter corner composition showing the entry door and the porch seating area. The home's facade is white-painted brick with a clean painted finish, punctuated by charcoal-painted louvered shutters flanking a multi-pane double-hung window on the left. The front entry features a beautiful arched surround in painted brick framing a pair of solid walnut doors with glass panels above and a traditional panel below, fitted with matte black hardware. The porch is supported by a square painted brick column, with the ceiling above finished in white-painted wood boards and showing exposed rough-hewn dark timber beam running overhead. A wooden rocking chair with a simple ivory linen cushion sits beside the door, with a small matching wooden side table. On and around the porch, large abundant hydrangea arrangements spill from a wicker basket, an aged white terracotta urn, and smaller stone vessels — all in full creamy white bloom with lush green foliage. A small lantern sits on the brick step. The brick porch floor is full-red aged brick. Two warm amber vertical glowing streaks emanate from wall-mount positions flanking the door surround on either side, casting warm pools of light on the white brick wall surface. Camera is at standing eye-level, three-quarter view of the porch corner. The mood is casual and inviting, a lush summery Southern residential entry.
